NONE: A1 some, or even the smallest amount or number of
一些；一點；若干
A1 one of or each of a particular type of person or thing when it is not important which
任何一個，無論哪個
B1 at all or in the least
根本；絲毫，略，稍

example: Is there any of that lemon cake left?
檸檬蛋糕有沒有剩下一點啊？
There was hardly any food left by the time we got there.
我們到那裡的時候，幾乎一點吃的都沒了。
"Is there some butter I could use?" "No, there's some margarine but there isn't any butter."
「還有奶油嗎？我要用點。」「沒了，人造奶油還有些，但是奶油一點都沒有了。」
"Is there any more soup?" "No, I'm afraid there isn't any left."
「還有湯嗎？」「抱歉，一點都沒有了。」
I haven't seen any of his movies.
他的電影我一部都沒看過。
I don't expect we'll have any more trouble from him.
我希望他再也不要給我們添任何麻煩了。
I go to church for weddings but not for any other reason.
我只有參加婚禮才會去教堂。
Are you sure there isn't any way of solving this problem?
你肯定這問題沒有任何解決辦法了？
Any food would be better than nothing at all.
有一點吃的總比甚麼都沒有好。
informal On Sundays I just wear any old thing (= anything) that I happen to find lying around.
星期天我是抓著哪件衣服就穿哪件。
Any of you should be able to answer this question.
你們隨便哪個都應該能回答這個問題。
Any idiot with a basic knowledge of French should be able to book a hotel room in Paris.
任何人只要懂點起碼的法語，都能在巴黎預訂一個旅館房間。
Any advice (= whatever advice) that you can give me would be greatly appreciated.
你給我甚麼建議我都會感激不盡。
Any minute/day/time now (= very soon) there's going to be a massive quarrel between those two.
他們兩個隨時都會大吵一場。
There were a lot of computers at the exhibition, any (one) of which would have suited me perfectly.
展覽會上有很多電腦，無論哪一台都會非常適合我用。
Can't you run any faster?
你不能再跑快一點嗎？
Those trousers don't look any different from the others.
那條褲子看起來和其他褲子沒甚麼兩樣。
Are you feeling any better after your illness?
你病癒後感覺身體好些了嗎？
Houses in this area used to be a real bargain, but they're not cheap any more (= now).
以前這一地區的房價非常低廉，但是現在可不便宜了。
This radio isn't any good (= it's useless) - I'll have to buy another.
這台收音機根本不好用，我還得再買一台。
I used to walk to work every day, but not any longer (= not now).
我以前每天都步行去上班，但是現在不了。
US informal I tried talking him out of it, but that didn't help any - he still left home.
我極力想勸阻他，但根本無濟於事，他還是離家而去。

NONE: › a very large amount of
極大量的…，很多…

example: We had any amount of people applying for the job.
有很多人到我們這兒來應徵這份工作。

NONE: A2 If you do not do something or something does not happen any more, you have stopped doing it or it does not now happen.
（不）再

example: I don't do yoga any more.
我不再做瑜伽了。

NONE: › a lot of a particular thing
許多，大量

example: The Cook's Shop stocks any number of different kinds of pasta.
「大廚店」大量出售各種義大利麵食。

NONE: › said to emphasize that it is better that something receives bad publicity than no publicity at all
任何宣傳都是好宣傳。
› in whatever way the situation is considered
不管從哪方面考慮

example: He shouldn't have hit her, any way you slice it.
無論如何他都不應該動手打她。

NONE: anyone
anyway
› informal also any old how without care or interest or in an untidy way
隨隨便便地；雜亂無章地

example: He looked a complete mess - dressed anyhow with his hair sticking up.
他那樣子邋遢透頂，衣衫不整，頭髮翹著。

NONE: A2 If you do not do something or something does not happen anymore, you have stopped doing it or it does not now happen.
（不）再

example: I don't do yoga anymore.
我不再做瑜伽了。

NONE: A2 used in questions and negatives to mean "a person or people"
（用於疑問句和否定句中）有人，任何人
B1 any person or any people
隨便哪個人

example: I haven't spoken to anyone all day.
我一整天都沒跟任何人說過話。
I haven't told anyone.
我沒有告訴任何人。
Was there anyone you knew at the meeting?
開會的人你有認識的嗎？
Has anyone seen my glasses anywhere?
有誰在哪裡看到我的眼鏡了嗎？
Anyone can go - you don't have to be invited.
誰都可以去，用不著邀請。
Anyone could dress well with all that money.
有了那些錢誰都可以穿得衣冠楚楚。

NONE: › all the most famous and important people
所有最有名的人，所有的重要人物

example: In those days anyone who was anyone dined in this exclusive little restaurant.
那個時候，所有有頭有臉的人物都到這家高級小餐館進餐。

NONE: › anywhere
隨便什麼地方

example: Oh just put it anyplace - it doesn't matter where.
隨便放哪裡都可以——哪裡都無所謂。

NONE: › Northern English for
anyway
A1 used in questions and negatives to mean "something"
（用於疑問句或否定句中）任何事物，任何東西
A1 any event, act, object, or situation
無論甚麼東西；隨便甚麼事情

example: Is there anything I can do to help?
有甚麼地方我可以幫忙的嗎？
Was there anything else you wanted to say or is that it?
你還有甚麼要說的嗎？還是就到此為止？
Do you have anything less expensive?
你們還有沒有便宜些的？
Let me know if anything happens, won't you?
發生甚麼事就告訴我，好嗎？
I didn't know anything about computers till I started this job.
在開始這項工作以前，我對電腦一無所知。
I was looking for a birthday present for my mother but I didn't find anything suitable.
我一直留意要給母親買件生日禮物，可一件合適的也沒有看到。
Did you notice anything strange about him?
你注意到他有甚麼異樣的地方嗎？
Spending Christmas with him and his brother - I can't imagine anything worse!
跟他們兄弟倆一起過聖誕節？我可想像不出比這更糟糕的事了！
If he eats anything with wheat in it he's very sick.
他吃任何含有小麥的食物，都會很不舒服。
"What did you do over the weekend?" "I don't think we did anything much."
「你們週末做了些甚麼了？」「甚麼也沒做。」
He said I could order anything on the menu.
他說菜單上的東西我可以隨便點。

NONE: › used to mean the opposite of the stated quality
恰恰不；根本不；決不

example: She's meant to be really nice but she was anything but nice when I met her.
她確實是想對別人好，可是我和她碰面的時候，她真的不怎麼樣。

NONE: › used with negatives to say that someone or something is not at all similar to someone or something else
（用於否定句中）全然，根本

example: The pictures on cereal boxes don’t look anything like the actual stuff you eat.
麥片包裝盒上的圖片跟真正吃到的一點兒也不像。

NONE: › anything could happen
任何事都可能發生

example: Well, if your brother can find a woman who's willing to marry him, then I suppose anything's possible.
如果你哥哥能找到一個願意嫁給他的女人，那我想天下真是沒有甚麼不可能的事了。

NONE: › at a time that is not or does not need to be decided or agreed
在任何時候

example: Call round to see me anytime.
甚麼時候有空就過來看看我。
We don't expect the economic situation to change anytime soon.
我們不指望經濟形勢馬上就能發生變化。

NONE: A2 whatever else is happening, without considering other things
不管怎樣；無論如何；仍然
A2 In conversation, anyway is also used to change the subject, return to an earlier subject, or get to the most interesting point.
（用於談話中表示改變話題、回到原來說的話題或者即將談到最有趣的一點）對了，好吧，無論如何，反正
B1 used to give a more important reason for something that you are saying
（用於談話中表示強調正在說的話）而且，加之，到底

example: Of course I don't mind taking you home - I'm going that way anyway.
我當然可以把你送回家——反正我也是順路。
"I thought you said everyone had left." "Well, some of them have anyway."
「你不是說所有人都走了嗎？」「噢，反正有些人已經走了。」
Her parents were opposed to her giving up her course, but she did it anyway.
她父母反對她放棄學業，但她還是沒有聽。
Anyway, as I said, I'll be away next week.
好了，我說過了，我下週就要離開了。
Anyway, in the end I didn't wear your jacket.
不管怎麼說，我終究也沒有穿你的夾克。
What was he doing with so much of the company's money in his personal account anyway?
他把那麼多的公司資金存在他個人帳戶裡到底是在搞甚麼名堂？
I don't have time to go, and anyway it's too expensive.
我沒有時間去，再說，也太貴了。

NONE: › informal for
anyway
A2 in, to, or at any place
在（或去）任何地方；隨便哪個地方
A2 used in questions or negatives to mean "a place"
（尤用於疑問句或否定句中）某個地方，任何地方
› used to say that a number or amount is in a certain range but that you cannot say exactly what it is
（在一定範圍內的）任何一處

example: You won't find a better plumber anywhere in England.
在英格蘭任何地方你都找不到比他更好的水管工了。
Go anywhere in the world and you'll find some sort of hamburger restaurant.
無論走到世界哪個地方，你都能看到這樣或那樣的漢堡速食店。
I was wondering if there was anywhere I could go to get this repaired.
我一直在想有沒有甚麼地方可以修這個東西。
There are quite a few words that they use in that part of the country that you don't hear anywhere else.
在那個鄉村地區的方言中，有許多詞彙是在其他任何地方都聽不到的。
They live in some tiny little village miles from anywhere (= a very long way from any towns).
他們住在一個小村子裡，到哪裡去都要走好遠的路。
I can't find my keys anywhere.
我哪裡都找不到我的鎖匙。
Is there anywhere in particular you wanted to go to eat tonight?
今晚你有沒有甚麼特別想去吃飯的地方？
Did you go anywhere interesting this summer?
今年夏天你去過甚麼有趣的地方嗎？
Is there anywhere to eat around here?
這附近有可以吃飯的地方嗎？
He charges anywhere from $20 to $50 for a haircut.
在他的理髮店，理髮收費在20到50美元之間。
As a teacher you could expect to be paid anywhere (= any amount) between £25 and £50 per hour.
作為一名教師，你可以期望得到每小時25到50英鎊的報酬。

NONE: C1 close in time, quality, distance, or amount
幾乎，差不多

example: Are we anywhere near finishing yet or is there still some way to go?
我們是快做完了，還是仍然差很多？
